title: Build a selected-translator PPC differential correctness oracle
goal: Validate the selected ReXGlue emission path with original synthetic PPC programs and an independent expected-results oracle, including the exact-math recipe.
acceptance: Cover arithmetic/CR/XER, endian memory, branches/calls/ABI and floating/vector edge cases supported by the selected translator; enumerate untested VMX128/nonlocal behavior
Use original instruction fixtures and independent expected results; a native host callback or copied translator implementation is not a differential oracle
Bind generator/config/compiler identities, retain counterexamples, and detect a deliberate incorrect-result mutation
validation: Generate and execute seeded plus fixed edge cases and confirm independent result agreement
Run the oracle mutation and supported sanitizer/platform checks; do not claim full ISA or gameplay parity
evidence: docs/engine/ppc-validation.md: original instruction fixtures, independent integer/rational expected state, exact-math/register/stack policy and production guest wraparound flags
Six final Windows/Linux native/sanitizer/held-out-seed runs: 2,410 cases each PASS; six full deliberate-result mutation runs each reject exactly the changed result
Two clean emissions per run and all six native cross-host outputs match; retained generator/runner, compile-command, input/case/log hashes rechecked against receipts
Windows Release tools/check.py: 98 Python tests, five explicit skips, native CTest PASS; Linux Release --sanitizers: 100 Python tests, no skips, ASan/UBSan CTest PASS
Synthetic subset only; SDK cores/generator uninstrumented, Windows uses UBSan traps; VMX128/nonlocal/full ISA/retail-console/performance/gameplay not certified; self-review only
